description: This JavaScript file provides shared utility functions for mapping status categories and strings to specific colors, with a focus on maintaining consistency and accessibility in dark-themed visualizations. It includes functions for generating deterministic pastel colors from arbitrary strings and mapping common statuses to theme-defined colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-oriented HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different inputs.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps status strings to theme colors or generates a deterministic color if the status is unrecognized, ensuring consistent color coding for statuses.
